newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST - SSAB 1996 profit down 48 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - SSAB 1996 profit down 48 pct.

text.p: Swedish steel company SSAB was expected to post a sharply lower profit after financial items of 1.98 billion crowns for calendar 1996, a Reuters poll of 13 analysts showed on Wednesday.
This would be a drop of 48 percent from 1995 when SSAB reported a profit of 3.83 billion crowns.
Forecasts for 1996 ranged from 1.79-2.10 billion crowns.
The company was forecast to propose a dividend payment of 4.15 a share, a rise from 4.00 crowns in 1995.

Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Carnegie, Enskilda, Foreningsbanken, Handelsbanken, Morgan Grenfell, James Capel, Nordiska Fondkommission, Swedbank, Paribas, Ohman, Kleinwort Benson, Fiba Nordics and Fischer Partners.
SSAB will release its 1996 earnings on February 13.
